commit_message:
[wasm][jspi] Switch to the central stack for fast API calls

This is done for the two kinds of fast API calls: the default
TurboFan-based wrappers, and the experimental WKI-based fast API calls
enabled by --wasm-fast-api.

findings.title: Missing FPRelativeOnly guard for regular wasm functions that switch stacks
findings.message: When regular wasm functions emit a SetStackPointer instruction (added to support central stack switching for Fast API calls), the SP is temporarily invalidated. The ARM64 code generator has an optimization in SlotToMemOperand() that converts FP-relative slot offsets to SP-relative memory operands when the encoding is more efficient. This optimization is gated by FPRelativeOnly(), but the SetFPRelativeOnly(true) call in AssembleCode() (src/compiler/backend/code-generator.cc) only covers WASM_TO_JS_FUNCTION code kind, kWasmToJsWrapperCSA, and wasm builtins — NOT regular WASM_FUNCTION code. As a result, after this commit introduced SetStackPointer into regular wasm Fast API call paths, the generated ARM64 code could use SP-relative operands during a window where the SP points to the central stack, causing accesses to the wrong memory region and triggering the 'metadata->Chunk() == this' CHECK failure in the heap.
findings.suggestion: The FPRelativeOnly guard must cover all code that may emit a SetStackPointer instruction, including regular WASM_FUNCTION code. The fix replaces the coarse-grained code-kind check with precise detection: during instruction selection, when a SetStackPointer opcode is encountered, set an 'invalidates_sp' flag on the Frame object. Then in the ARM64 operand converter, check frame()->invalidates_sp() instead of FPRelativeOnly(). This ensures any function that actually performs a stack switch — regardless of code kind — disables the SP-relative operand optimization for its entire compilation.

ground_truth.root_cause: The guard that disables SP-relative memory operand generation (SetFPRelativeOnly) in src/compiler/backend/code-generator.cc only covered WASM_TO_JS_FUNCTION code kind, kWasmToJsWrapperCSA, and wasm builtins. When commit 5e09e2aaf1d added SetStackPointer to regular wasm function code paths (for Fast API calls), the WASM_FUNCTION code kind was not included in the guard, leaving the SP-relative operand optimization active during stack switches.
